title: Thi sada ye zainab ki aye hussain ke bhai
body:
THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, DEKHO MERI TANHAI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
KARBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN MUJHSE CHUT GAYA AKBAR, BHAI PAR FIDA HOKAR CHAL BASE MERE DILBAR, TUM BHI ROOTH KAR MUJHSE SOGAYE HODARIYA PAR, KAISI TUMKO NEEND AAYI AYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
MERI MANNATOU WALA WO MERA ALI AKBAR, CHAL BASA HAI DUNIYA SE SEENE PAR SINA KHAKAR, NOUJAWAAN KE LAASHE PAR POUNCHE JIS GHADI SARWAR, JA CHUKI THI BINAEE AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
BAD-E- ASR-E-ASHOORA HAR QADAM PA AAFAT THI, SHUMR KE TAMACHE THE BEKASI THI GHURBAT THI, PHIR YATEEMO KE SAR PAR EK NAYI MUSIBAT THI, ZULM KI GHATA CHHAYI AYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
<<DIVIDER>>
BHAI TERE MARNE SE WO JAFA HUI HUM PAR, KARBALA SE KUFA TAK HUM PHIRE BA REHNA SAR, BHAI TERI ZAINAB KE FARQ PAR NA THI CHADAR, KHALQ THI TAMASHAYI AYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
AB BHI HAI NIGHAO MEIN WO LAHOO BHARA MANZAR, THA GIRA LAEENAO MEIN IBNE FATEHE QAIBAR, TEEN DIN KE PYAASE KE HALQ PAR CHALA KHANJAR, KYON NA MUJHKO MOUT AAYI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
HO KAHA MERE BHAIYYA LO QABAR ZARA UTH KAR, SHUMR NE SAKINA KE CHEENE KANOU SE GAUHAR, QAID HOKE JATI HAI DAR BA DAR TERI QWAHER, KYA KARE YE MAA JAYI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
KAR QUBOOL YE NOUHA IBNE SAQIYA KAUSAR, MOOSAVI KO BULWALE JALD APNE ROUZE PAR, AUR PADHE YE PARWANE TERE ROUZE PAR AAKAR, AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI..
